messages.author: Matthew Guberman-Pfeffer
messages.body:
Dear Amber Community,
I’d like to run separate instances of esander using two different topologies loaded into the same cpptraj session. Is this possible? I don’t see an option for the esander command to specify which topology to use. I tried a sequential approach of loading in prmtop #1, running esander, then loading in prmtop #2 and running esander again, but the energies look identical, causing me to think that esander was always using the first loaded topology.
Best,
Matthew

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
You could try:
parm parm1
trajin traj1 parmindex 0
esander E1 …
run
clear trajin
parm parm2
trajin traj2 parmindex 1
esander E2 …
run
You could also load the trajectories as COORDS data sets with ‘loadcrd’ and
use ‘crdaction’.
Hope this helps,
-Dan
